description:
The wild is in danger - the animals need you now! A mysterious disaster has scattered creatures far from their habitats, and only sharp thinking and a brave heart can bring them home.

In Madagascar: Zoo Animals Adventures, every level is a thrilling rescue mission! Sort, rotate, and fit each animal perfectly into place, saving them from being lost forever. With each puzzle solved, you rebuild a shattered world - unlocking new exotic species and stunning zoo locations.

This isn’t just a game, it’s a race against time to save the wild. Gear up, stay sharp, and become the ultimate hero for the animal kingdom!
name: Madagascar: Zoo Animals Adventures
intro: Rescue, sort, and settle the wild!
